verdict.rationale: Hugging Face's own `hf` CLI lets an agent list the models currently served by Inference Providers (`hf models ls --warm`), so the catalog can be enumerated programmatically. However, no evidence documents an OpenAI-style GET /v1/models HTTP endpoint: the OpenAI drop-in claim covers chat completions only, and the openapi.json probe does not show a models-list route. Missing for 10: a documented GET /v1/models-style HTTP endpoint on the Inference Providers router, response schema and filtering docs, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the listing reflects the live catalog.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint

citations.quote:
# Find models served by Inference Providers
hf models ls --warm
Point it at Inference Providers to run [the latest open models available](https://huggingface.co/models?inference_provider=all) with a single Hugging Face token.
